name: Canadian Psychiatric Association 76th Annual Conference 2026
description: The 76th Annual Conference of the Canadian Psychiatric Association takes place at the Centre Sheraton Montreal. Preconference courses run on Wednesday 18 November and the main scientific programme, with keynote plenaries and concurrent sessions, runs from 19 to 21 November 2026.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: Midnight Pacific Time; courses, general sessions, research papers and posters (research and early investigator categories).

deadlines.label: Early registration
deadlines.note: Early rates 22 August to 30 October; regular rates 31 October to 21 November.

sources.note: Dates 18 to 21 November 2026, Centre Sheraton Montreal.
